name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-extensions-react-teamschatNotifications
title: Teams Chat Notifications
shortDescription: Show Teams chat notifications and unread-message counts in SharePoint.
longDescription: A React application customizer that displays an unread-message badge and a list of Teams chat notifications on SharePoint pages. Microsoft Graph subscriptions and Azure SignalR deliver messages through the companion Azure Functions project.

thumbnails.alt: Teams chat notification badge and messages on a SharePoint page

references.name: Overview of SharePoint Framework Extensions
references.description: Documentation for extending the SharePoint user experience with SharePoint Framework extensions.
